name: Condition Immunity
description: Wards the body against a single debilitating condition.

mechanics.text: On activation, grants immunity to one condition (set when authored) for 1 hour. Same severity ladder as feat.impose-condition (its own inverse), reused rather than reinvented — being immune to paralysis is roughly as impactful as being able to inflict it.
Immune to a condition that's a real inconvenience but rarely swings a fight on its own — frightened, blinded, deafened, prone, grappled, and similar.
Immune to a condition with real tactical weight — poisoned, charmed, restrained, exhausted, possessed, and similar.
Immune to a condition that would otherwise effectively take the target out of the fight — stunned, incapacitated, unconscious, banished, and similar.
Immune to the most dangerous save-or-suffer outcomes in the game — paralyzed, petrified.
